items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: The only time I ever saw her was in 45, in 43, when she came here.

ctx.x: When did you ever see her first? The only time I ever saw her was in 45, in 43, when she came here. When she came here. And I mean, I was just surprised, because he never did like fat women. She was so fat. Mm-hmm. But she said how good she was to him, and how she'd given him all the time.
She probably did take care of him.
